title: Concept: Sensitive value in log call (go) — review required
description: In go, (?:log.(?:Print|Fatal)|fmt.Print)w*s*([^)]*(?:password|passw places a credential-named value on a log line. Log pipelines retain data for months and expose it to support tooling, so logged secrets effectively become shared. The remedy is logging presence flags or redacted markers.
applicability: go codebases emitting logs; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential disclosure to log readers and retention stores; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when logs ship to third parties.
